outcome: obesity-related outcomes (body mass index [BMI], waist circumference [WC], skinfold thickness [SF], body fat, blood pressure, lipids, blood glucose, abdominal obesity risks)
cohort: The study consisted of 677 Chinese children whose birth weight, obesity-related outcomes, and behavior problems were collected.
finding: Marginally low birth weight was associated with higher risks of various obesity-related outcomes, with these associations partially mediated by an increased risk of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder or abnormal eating behavior.
